prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. FOUR-direction IDLE atlas of the SAME unarmed rescued yang_lin, natural mature adult anatomy from reference1. Reference1 is definitive body proportions and the SAME face/hair/costume. Reference2 only helps historical costume details/back views; ignore bindings, weapons and short anatomy. Preserve mature proportions, neck and hip/leg lengths, normal small head/hands/boots across ALL views. Body about7 heads tall, long adult legs taking half height; do not compress thighs/calves to fit grid.
Identity details: Lean man, pointed short black beard and moustache, blue-black tied headscarf, tan LEOPARD-SPOTTED fur tunic and pale short rolled sleeves, blue sash, dark blue shin wraps and cloth boots. Preserve spots not tiger stripes. No helmet or weapon.
Exactly FOUR whole figures in equal TWO-by-TWO cells: upper-left SE FRONT-three-quarter facing DOWN-RIGHT; upper-right SW FRONT-three-quarter facing DOWN-LEFT; lower-left NE REAR-three-quarter facing UP-RIGHT; lower-right NW REAR-three-quarter facing UP-LEFT. Back views show back of head, torso and garment (no front chest/eyes). Whole body, hips, boots and head face stated direction. SAME moderately elevated isometric camera/painterly rendering as reference1. SAME scale, natural mature anatomy, face identity and consistent garment hem/cape length/materials in all cells. Quiet standing with both feet close and grounded, empty hands at sides, wrists free, upright spine/slight tired shoulders. No hunched peeking, crouch, raised knee, bound-wrists pose or running. Arms must NOT cross as if bound. Leopard fur has varied irregular open rosettes and spots, never evenly tiled flowers or tiger stripes. Keep original distinct colors and accessories; do not borrow other character's mask/armor.
No weapons/sheath/rope/bindings/sacks/flags/mount/blood/glow/new props. Figure about75–80% CELL height, full silhouettes/headcloth tails/cape/fingers/boots inside their cells, generous clear gutters/all edge margins, no clipped toes/tails. GENUINE transparent alpha, square native max1536, no floor/shadow/grid/text/labels/checkerboard.
